prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: hit while turning left. Injury: neck strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was proceeding through an intersection while making a left turn when your insured's vehicle struck the driver's side of our client's car. The police report and the photographs taken at the scene document the point of impact and the resulting damage.

As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a neck strain that has caused ongoing pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. Our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has followed the treatment plan recommended by the treating physician, including physical therapy and prescribed medication. Records confirm that the symptoms began immediately after the impact and have continued to affect daily activities, work duties, and sleep.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to yield the right of way and caused the collision. Our client bears no responsibility for what occurred.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company.

Please direct all future correspondence regarding this claim to our office.
